bug_semantics: The rating block accepted customIcon.svg as an unrestricted string and inserted it into the live bot DOM as HTML. A malicious imported typebot or workspace collaborator could store event-handler-bearing HTML/SVG; builder preview rendered it inline on builder.typebot.io rather than in the isUnsafe Web Worker used for Script blocks, causing stored XSS in the privileged builder origin and bypassing the intended import-preview sandbox boundary.
flaw_origin: b1aecf843b28e0c06cf7c43f59cc5ebd661da416 introduced the complete unsafe rating feature: its new builder setting stored arbitrary SVG text, its new model admitted customIcon.svg with z.string().optional(), and its new React RatingForm rendered that value through dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization. Later refactors preserved the sink, and 3487850b9f4808617d347ddde4d9701f56662894 copied the already-vulnerable rating renderer into the new Solid-based packages/js implementation as part of a large bot-v2 migration.
